title: A CL program that trusts the library list
prompt: ARCHIVE.clle names every object without a library, so what it clears and deletes depends on whichever library list the job happens to have — and in production that list starts with production. Qualify every object reference with the library DEVCFC, and take the library from a parameter with DEVCFC as its default rather than hard-coding it in each command.
check: ! codeonly ARCHIVE.clle | grep -qiE '(OBJ|FILE|TOFILE|FROMFILE)\( *[A-Z0-9#$@]+ *\)' && codeonly ARCHIVE.clle | grep -qiE 'PGM *PARM\(' && codeonly ARCHIVE.clle | grep -qiE 'DCL +VAR\(&LIB' && [ $(codeonly ARCHIVE.clle | grep -ciE '&LIB/') -ge 3 ]
